subject: Demo booking conflict: StellarPay inbound signup / SDR ownership
body:
From: Demo Bot <demos@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@stellarpay.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Your Redwood demo is scheduled — Mar 15 11:00am PT

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up — your demo with Redwood is confirmed for Mon, Mar 15 at 11:00 AM PT. Marissa Cole (SDR) is assigned to your account and will send a calendar invite with dial-in details. If you need to reschedule, reply to this email and we’ll take care of it.

Attachment: demo-invite.ics (calendar invite stub)

—
Redwood Demo Team
demos@redwood.com

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:20:15 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Your Redwood demo is scheduled — Mar 15 11:00am PT

Connor / Vivek — heads up: inbound self-serve from StellarPay (Alex Mercer). Demo bot auto-assigned the booking to me, but last-touch and territory rules look like this should route to Connor (EMEA/Enterprise). I’m in SDR rotation for inbound US mid-market, so there’s a territory overlap.

Quick facts:
- Lead email: alex@stellarpay.com
- Company: StellarPay (10–50 FTE, payments stack)
- Source: marketing demo signup (web)
- HubSpot company: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7890

I’m happy to own the first demo session and hand off to Connor if it turns enterprise, but want to avoid double outreach and confusing the customer. Can we decide who sends the calendar invite and who will own follow-up?

I attached a quick export of the lead record I pulled.

Attachment: lead-export.csv

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

-----

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:25:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Your Redwood demo is scheduled — Mar 15 11:00am PT

Marissa — thanks for the flag. Per our territory map (last update 2026-02-01) StellarPay maps to Connor-owned accounts for any company with >5 existing integrations and >$1M ARR potential (proxy indicators: payments, integrations list). I pulled the account and there’s a note from Sales Ops showing an inbound MQL owner rotation to me. I’m happy to let you run the intro demo as a favor to speed time-to-first-touch, but ownership for follow-up/contracting should be with me.

Can we do the following?
1) Marissa: send the customer the confirmed calendar invite (you already have it) and handle the discovery/demo on Mar 15.
2) Connor: I’ll be on the call as an observer; if it becomes procurement-level, I’ll be the AE who takes post-demo next steps.
3) Marissa: please update the HubSpot owner to Connor after the demo finishes and add a note with the call summary and next-step disposition.

If anyone disagrees with the mapping, ping me — I’ll coordinate with Sales Ops.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien | Senior AE, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

-----

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:45:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Your Redwood demo is scheduled — Mar 15 11:00am PT

Thanks for the clear proposal. My +1 on this handoff plan — we want quick customer-facing motion (Marissa runs the demo) and clean post-demo ownership (Connor takes the account if it qualifies). Jasmine, please make sure Sales Ops updates the territory mapping so the routing rule reflects this case to avoid future duplication.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

-----

From: Alex Mercer <alex@stellarpay.com>
To: demos@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Your Redwood demo is scheduled — Mar 15 11:00am PT

Hi Marissa — thanks for the confirmation and for coordinating. Quick ask: can we move to Tue, Mar 16 at 10:00 AM PT instead? One of our engineers is tied up on Mar 15. Otherwise Mar 15 works.

Also looping Tara (tara.singh@stellarpay.com) — she’ll handle procurement and contract questions. Tara, you may want Connor on the call.

Best,
Alex Mercer
Head of Product | StellarPay
alex@stellarpay.com | +1 (415) 555-0201
